AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Food Nutrients and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Trees and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Establishment Planting Site and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Crop Management Practises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.

4. A — Glucose and oxygen

5. D — 100 °C

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.
